facts.fact: Togo First says BCEAO's PI-SPI instant-payment platform, launched in September 2025, lets Togo's six BCEAO-authorised institutions transfer funds instantly 24 hours a day.
Togo First says six Togo institutions are authorised by BCEAO on its list of 24 February 2026 to offer PI-SPI, the WAEMU regional instant-payment platform, up from three at launch.

systems.platform: Plateforme interopérable du système de paiement instantané
